One version for everything: this release carries the server, the desktop apps, the Android app and the browser extension together. The desktop app moves to Wails 3 with a window at the tray icon, the browser extension asks for website access only for Click'n'Load, and yt-dlp keeps itself current. Every change is listed in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## ✨ Added

- **A small window at the tray icon.** A click on KnightLoader's icon in the notification area or the menu bar opens it: total speed, active, queued, done and failed downloads, captchas waiting, what is downloading right now and the latest downloads, with buttons to stop or start the queue and to open the main window. Drag its edges to resize it; it remembers the size.
- **The tray menu stops and starts the queue**, in the language of the interface.
- **yt-dlp keeps itself up to date.** Once a day KnightLoader fetches a newer yt-dlp, checks it against the release's checksum and makes sure it runs before switching to it. If anything fails, the one you have stays. The switch is on the Tools card under Settings, Resolvers, and it is on from the start.
- **More spans for the downloaded volume, and one of your own**: 7 days, 30 days, 90 days, 12 months, all time, or any number of days or months. The card remembers what you picked.
- **The container image is on Docker Hub too**, as `junkerderprovinz/knightloader`.

## 🎨 Design

- **The desktop app's icon has no dark square behind the logo**, and in the taskbar and the notification area the logo is as tall as the icons beside it.
- **The Overview's Instances card shows name and state**, with the badge at the right edge.
- **The downloaded volume's selectors sit under the chart.**
- **The browser extension's instance cards say Connected and Not connected**, like the web interface and the app.

## ⚡ Improved

- **One version number for everything.** The server, the desktop apps, the Android app and the browser extension are released together, and each release carries the APK and the extension zip next to the desktop downloads.
- **The browser extension asks for access to all websites only for Click'n'Load.** Installing it asks for no website access. Switching Click'n'Load on asks, you can say no, and switching it off gives the access back. Sending a page, link, image or selection reads the tab only when you click the extension's button or one of its right-click entries.
- **The browser extension's instance cards drop their start and stop buttons.** The extension catches and sends links; the queue runs from the web interface, the app or the desktop tray.
- **The desktop app runs on Wails 3 and its own tray.** On macOS the tray and the window no longer compete for the main thread, which could end a start in a crash.
- **The README's badges** show the lint run, the Docker Hub pulls and size, the desktop app, the three download engines, the manual and the release downloads.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **Downloads no longer race inside the download library.** Starting, pausing and showing progress at the same moment could read and change a download's state without a lock.

## 🌐 Translations

- Every new text in all 42 languages, in the web interface, the desktop tray and the browser extension.

## 📋 Notes

- **Once after the update on macOS and Linux**, the desktop window forgets the language and look you chose and starts from your system's, because it loads the interface from a new address.
- **After the update, Click'n'Load may ask once more** for website access. Chrome and Edge keep it.
- **The browser extension needs Firefox 140, or 142 on Android.**
- **The Android app updates the installed 1.3.0.**
